target: team points in the NEXT game (= points allowed by the opposing defence), one row per team-game, regular season, game-clustered paired bootstrap; negative diff = new rating better

conference_offsets.decision_rule: adopt only if the best development variant beats the module baseline with a game-clustered 95% CI below 0 (all weeks, FBS-vs-FBS)

rank_band.note: coverage = share of teams whose week-w rating lies within the 80% interval of the independent rest-of-season rating (z = diff / sqrt(inflation*se_w^2 + se_truth^2)); the inflation is the smallest factor reaching 80% on DEVELOPMENT; validation/holdout show the same factor out of sample. 'rank_band' is the share of teams whose rest-of-season rank falls inside the published rank band (inflation 1): descriptive, because the truth rank is itself noisy.
